title: Near-Linear Accuracy Bounds for Moreau--Yosida Unadjusted Langevin Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2609.40193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We establish near-linear accuracy bounds for the classical Moreau--Yosida unadjusted Langevin algorithm (MYULA). The target is $\pi\propto e^{-f-g}$, where $f\in C^2(\mathbb{R}^d)$ is $m$-strongly convex with Lipschitz gradient and $g$ is convex and globally Lipschitz. Under an explicit parameter-dependent step-size condition, we bound the invariant-measure bias relative to the Moreau-smoothed target by $\widetilde O(h)$, with only logarithmic dependence on the inverse smoothing parameter in the error coefficient. translated_title: Moreau-Yosida未调整朗之万采样的近线性精度界
translated_abstract: 我们为经典的Moreau-Yosida未调整朗之万算法（MYULA）建立了近线性精度界。目标分布为 π ∝ e^{-f-g}，其中 f ∈ C²(ℝ^d) 是 m-强凸且梯度Lipschitz的函数，g 是凸且全局Lipschitz的函数。在显式的参数相关步长条件下，我们将不变测度相对于Moreau平滑目标分布的偏差限制在 Õ(h) 范围内，且误差系数中对平滑参数的倒数仅有对数级依赖。将这一估计与Moreau逼近偏差和Wasserstein收缩相结合，在模型参数和初始化固定的条件下，仅需 Õ(ε^{-1}) 次迭代即可使第N次迭代的分布 μ_N 满足 √m·W₂(μ_N, π) ≤ ε。我们直接对平稳误差进行界定，无需假设三阶导数存在或Hessian矩阵Lipschitz。每次迭代仅需一次梯度计算和一次精确的邻近算子求值。
tldr: 该论文为MYULA算法建立了近线性精度界，证明在无需三阶导数或Lipschitz Hessian的较强假设下，每次迭代仅需一次梯度计算和一次邻近算子求值，即可在 Õ(ε^{-1}) 次迭代内使采样分布达到ε精度的Wasserstein误差。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes near-linear accuracy bounds for MYULA, showing that with only one gradient evaluation and one proximal evaluation per iteration—and without requiring third derivatives or a Lipschitz Hessian—Õ(ε^{-1}) iterations suffice to achieve ε accuracy in Wasserstein distance.
